sources.text: # Run and deploy your AI Studio app This contains everything you need to run your app locally. View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/9ab089f4-a1e6-43bd-84fd-1e01e8a3c8df ## Run Locally **Prerequisites:** Node.js 1. Install dependencies: `npm install` 2. Set the `GEMINI_API_KEY` in [.env.local](.env.local) to your Gemini API key 3. Run the app: `npm run dev`

An AI-powered LPG customer complaint resolution portal that intelligently classifies complaints, generates standardized responses, summarizes complaint history, and demonstrates real-time emergency escalation workflows with automated distributor and consumer notifications for critical safety incidents.
